---
title: "Alcohol Sales After COVID-19"
---

## Project description

Alcohol sales at Austin bars and restaurants fell sharply during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, but recovery has varied across neighborhoods and drink types. Using state tax data, this project examines how sales changed over time, which areas rebounded fastest, and how consumer spending shifted across beer, wine and liquor.

This final project works to answer the question: How did COVID-19 affect alcohol sales in Austin, and how did recovery vary by area?
